# omadafusion_gateway_acls (Data Source)

All gateway ACL rules in evaluation order. Useful for auditing and for importing existing rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_gateway_acls" "all" {}

output "acl_order" {
  value = [for a in data.omadafusion_gateway_acls.all.acls : "${a.index}: ${a.name} (${a.enabled ? a.policy : "disabled"})"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site name or ID.

### Read-Only

- `acls` (Attributes List) Rules, first match first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acls))

<a id="nestedatt--acls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `acls`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enforced.
- `id` (String) Rule ID.
- `index` (Number) 1-based position.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `policy` (String) `deny` or `permit`.
